description: This file implements a backend for managing Git references in files, including reading, writing, locking, renaming, and pruning references and reflogs. It contains functions for reference storage, ref lock management, reflog handling, and reference iteration within a file-based repository structure.

classes.name: ref_lock
classes.description: Represents a lock on a reference, including ref name, lock file, old object ID, and usage count.

classes.name: files_ref_store
classes.description: Represents a file-based reference store, managing flags, directories, cache, and related operations.

classes.name: ref_to_prune
classes.description: Structure for references scheduled for pruning, including reference name and associated object ID.

classes.name: fill_root_ref_data
classes.description: Data structure used when adding root references to a ref directory.

classes.name: files_ref_iterator
classes.description: Iterator over file-based references, supporting advance, seek, and release operations.

classes.name: rename_cb
classes.description: Callback data structure for renaming logs, including temporary filename and error tracking.

methods.description: Callback function to fill root references into a ref directory.
